[LTHE.2.5.5] **`latest` pins the anchor; later steps still fan out.** With
`latest`, the sequence's first pattern matches only the most recent fact of
its schema. Each later step still matches every fact that falls in its
window, so the rule fires once per complete chain rooted at that anchor: if
two facts match the second step and each is followed by a fact matching the
third, the rule fires twice. Refraction suppresses a re-fire on a chain the
rule has already fired on.
